：圣女大人，我帮你上药！（：圣女大人，我帮你上药！（第22页）江澜：“……”“接下来，我用最诚恳、最直白、最不绕弯子的话问你，账册在哪儿？”沈清寒长出一口气。“南城。”南城？江澜倒是有些印象。之前路过那贫民区，就是南城来着。沈清寒继续道：“我回京城后，把原本的账册，交给一个我曾经帮助过的账房先生了。”江澜问道：“嗯，所以他人呢？”“死了。”江澜；“……”没理会江澜的表情，沈清寒继续道：“进京没多久，他便病死了。”只能说，这年头是这样的。别管是京城还是什么城，病死个把人，那都太正常不过了。“不过……”沈清寒又继续道，“他有两个孙女。”“呃，所以他孙女呢？”“我不知道。”沈清寒道，“但那账房先生受过我的恩惠，他说过的，便是死，也不会让东西丢了。但我进京没多久，便被镇魔司的人带到这来了，所以……”江澜沉默半晌。“多大？”“什么？”“你应该是d，不过我问的是那两个孩子多大。”沈清寒忽略了前半段她听不懂的话，回答道：“大的八九岁，小的四五岁，都是女孩，除了那老账房，她们俩应该没别的亲人了，我也不知道在哪儿。”大的八九岁，小的四五岁吗？两个女孩，没有家人，又是城南。所以，就是他之前遇见那两个小丫头？吊毛作者，伏笔都是现用现埋的吗？草蛇灰线懂不懂啊？沈清寒看见江澜的表情，有些疑惑地问道：“你见过她们？”“呃……可能应该也许大概是……见过？”他其实也不确定，之前遇见的那两个小姑娘，到底是不是他要找的人。沈清寒闻言，当即便有些紧张道：“她们还活着？”“呃……可能应该也许大概是……活着？”江澜看向沈清寒，“不过听你这话，好像有些意外？”“不……我只是……她们两个那么小，我不知道她们是怎么活下来的……”“得得得。”江澜连忙抬手制止沈清寒继续说下去，“你先别急着悲天悯人。”“那账册，多半是能换你的命的，我问你，你是换，还是不换？”“不换……”沈清寒一脸坚定地摇头，“也不能换，账册关系着太多，我要把……”“怎么滴？”江澜打断沈清寒，“听你这意思，你还要揭露黑暗？咋的，你想化身利刃，揭穿这腐朽的时代是不是？”沈清寒：“……”“我有些乏了，明日再说吧。”随着沈清寒话音落下，江澜脑海深处，囚神碑忽然一震。漆黑石碑上，字迹浮现。江澜眼前一亮。“好了，现在明日到了，接着说吧。”沈清寒：“？？”“你不说明日吗？”江澜一脸正经，“现在子时刚过，不就明日了吗。”“你怎么知道？”“那你别管，我有独特的计时方法。”

"Next, I will ask you in the most sincere, straightforward and least roundabout way, where are the account books?" Shen Qinghan took a breath. "Nancheng." Nancheng? Jiang Lan had some impressions. The slum area he passed by before was Nancheng. Shen Qinghan continued: "After I returned to the capital, I handed over the original account books. A bookkeeper I once helped. "Jiang Lan asked: "Well, so where is the other person?" "Dead." Jiang Lan; "..." Ignoring Jiang Lan's expression, Shen Qinghan continued: "Not long after he entered Beijing, he died of illness. "It can only be said that this is the case in these days. Regardless of whether it is the capital or any other city, it is normal for a lot of people to die from illness. "But..." Shen Qinghan continued. , "He has two granddaughters." "Uh, so where are his granddaughters?" "I don't know." Shen Qinghan said, "But the accountant has received a favor from me. He said that even if he died, he would not let the things be lost. But not long after I entered the capital, I was brought here by the people from the Suppression Division, so..." Jiang Lan was silent for a while. "How old?" "What?" "You should be D, but I'm asking about those two. How old are the children?" Shen Qinghan ignored the words she didn't understand in the first half and replied: "The older one is eight or nine years old, and the younger one is four or five years old. They are both girls. Apart from the old accountant, they have no other relatives. I don't know where they are. "The older one is eight or nine years old, and the younger one is four or five years old? Two girls, no family, and they are in the south of the city. So, it was the two little girls he met before? Author of Diao Mao, Fu Are the pens used and buried now? Do you understand? Shen Qinghan saw Jiang Lan's expression and asked with some confusion: "Have you seen them?" "Uh... maybe maybe..." He was actually not sure whether the two little girls he met before were the ones he was looking for. When Shen Qinghan heard this, he said a little nervously: "Are they still alive?" "Uh... Maybe maybe...alive?" Jiang Lan looked at Shen Qinghan, "But you seem a little surprised by what you said?" "No...I just...the two of them are so young, I don't know how they survived..." Jiang Lan quickly raised his hand to stop Shen Qinghan from continuing, "Don't be too impatient to be merciful." "That account book can probably change your life. You, do you want to change, or not?" "No..." Shen Qinghan shook his head firmly, "I can't change, the account book has too much to do, I want to..." "What?" Jiang Lan interrupted Shen Qinghan, "What do you mean, you want to turn into a sharp blade and expose this decadent era, right?" Shen Qinghan: "..." "I'm a little tired, let's talk about it tomorrow." As Shen Qinghan finished speaking, the Prison God Monument suddenly shook. Writings appeared on the dark stone monument. Jiang Lan's eyes lit up. "Okay, now tomorrow is here, let's continue." Shen Qinghan: "??" "Don't you say tomorrow?" Jiang Lan looked serious, "It's just past midnight, isn't it tomorrow?" "How do you know?" "Then don't worry, I have a unique way of timing."
